title: What Would It Take to Prove Christianity True?

top_liked.text: I like the comment from Matt Dillahunty on this.. "I don't know what would prove Christianity but God would so why doesn't he make that proof available to us?" And no, a book riddled with contradictions and lies does not count as "proof".

top_liked.text: I think the only way Jesus could be fully human and fully divine is if human nature itself is divine. If that's the case, then Jesus' sacrifice is unnecessary.
